subject: BlueRoute discovery recap & MAP
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@blueroute.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 14:00:00 -0800
Subject: BlueRoute discovery recap & MAP

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the time today. Below is a concise recap of what we heard on the call and a proposed Mutual Action Plan so we can align on stakeholders, deliverables, and dates.

Key pain points you called out:
- High per-query latency on the routing inference at peak (currently ~2–3s for a subset of flows)
- Unit inference cost is materially impacting margins as traffic scales
- Need for a deployment option that satisfies EU data residency and stricter access controls

Primary goals we discussed:
- Reduce 95th percentile latency to <600ms for production traffic
- Reduce per-inference cost by ~40% compared to current baseline
- Run a private/VPC pilot for EU region to validate security and residency controls

Proposed high-level Mutual Action Plan (MAP):
1) Pilot kickoff — Technical deep-dive + dataset exchange — owner: Camila Reyes — target: 2027-02-18
2) Pilot staging deployment — infra setup & baseline measurement — owner: Rishi Malhotra — target: 2027-03-04
3) Cost & quality evaluation — joint review with BlueRoute stakeholders — target: 2027-03-18
4) Procurement & SOW sign-off — procurement/legal loop — target: 2027-04-01

I've attached a first-pass MAP workbook for your review (BlueRoute_MAP_v1.xlsx). Please confirm the stakeholders above and the target dates; if procurement should be involved now, share their contact and I will add them to the plan.

Happy to hop on a 30-min follow-up this week if you'd like to walk through the MAP line-by-line.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Appreciate the quick responses. Per Daniel's request, attaching an updated MAP (PDF) with explicit success metrics, owners, and a suggested timeline. Summarized below so it's easy to skim.

Mutual Action Plan — detailed (summary):
- Milestone 1: Pilot kickoff / technical deep-dive
  Owner (Redwood): Camila Reyes
  Owner (BlueRoute): Daniel Park
  Deliverables: shared dataset sample, API access, success criteria doc
  Target date: 2027-02-18
- Milestone 2: Staging pilot deployment & baseline measurement
  Owner (Redwood): Rishi Malhotra
  Owner (BlueRoute): Engineering lead (TBD)
  Deliverables: staging deployment, latency & cost baselines, initial optimization runs
  Target date: 2027-03-04
- Milestone 3: Joint evaluation — cost vs quality
  Owners: BlueRoute execs + Redwood account team
  Deliverables: evaluation report, recommended model/config & cost projection
  Target date: 2027-03-18
- Milestone 4: Procurement / SOW / legal review
  Owner (BlueRoute): Procurement
  Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole
  Deliverables: SOW draft, pricing table, implementation plan
  Target date: 2027-04-01

Success metrics (pilot):
- 95th pct latency <600ms on measured requests in staging
- Per-inference cost delta <= -40% vs current baseline
- No PII/exfiltration risks in private deployment; pass security checklist (Priya to confirm criteria)

Estimated pilot duration: ~3 weeks from kickoff to baseline measurement (we've suggested the 2/18 -> 3/04 window). We'll provide a pilot estimate and a preliminary pricing range for procurement by 2/12 so you have it ahead of the kickoff.

Deal ID: BR-2027-045
Attached: BlueRoute_MAP_v1.pdf (updated with owners and deliverables)

Next actions:
- Daniel / Priya / Procurement: confirm the names of the engineering lead and the procurement POC by 2/12
- Marissa: send pilot estimate and pricing range by 2/12 (I will)
- Camila / Rishi: prep a short tech checklist for the deep-dive (Camila will send)

Thanks — I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a 2/18 kickoff unless you prefer a different cadence.

Best,

Marissa Cole
